items.title: WhatsApp Introduces Username Feature for Connecting Without Sharing Phone Numbers
items.description: WhatsApp is preparing to roll out a long-anticipated username feature that will allow users to communicate without ever revealing their phone numbers, a significant privacy upgrade for one of the world’s most widely used messaging platforms.
